# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 stable release** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and improves managed rendering and text performance. It adds .NET 11 WebAssembly assets, removes allocation-heavy text helpers, and fixes an encoded-image native resource leak.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Ships the m151 renderer with subsequent upstream bug-fix syncs. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## API Surface

- **Span-based color parsing added** — SKColor hexadecimal parsing supports ReadOnlySpan<char> inputs without intermediate strings. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Encoded image creation no longer leaks native resources** — SKImage.FromEncodedData with a subset releases native resources correctly. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly assets added** — Provides Emscripten 5.0.6 native libraries with modern exception handling for .NET 11 WebAssembly. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed color and text paths reduce allocations** — Color conversion, tag parsing, shaping results, and UTF-8 buffer input avoid unnecessary native calls and temporary allocations. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Improves HarfBuzzSharp text input and tag parsing by eliminating avoidable allocations.
